summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the first tranche closing of a private offering. The company issued unsecured promissory notes for up to US$10M aggregate principal (funded at US$2M in the first tranche), warrants for up to 29,122,679 ordinary shares at US$2.00 per share, pre-funded warrants for 1,143,962 shares, and 676,205 ordinary shares. The offering is structured in tranches under an equity purchase agreement allowing up to US$100M in ordinary share sales. Revere Securities LLC acted as placement agent on a reasonable best-efforts basis, receiving 5.0% gross proceeds cash fee plus 0.5% expense allowance. Officers and 10%+ beneficial owners entered into 180-day lock-up agreements. The securities are unregistered, with a registration rights agreement requiring a resale registration statement filing by August 15, 2026 or 15 days after the 20-F filing. This is a routine capital-raising financing structure, not a special situation event.
